claim_ceiling: Finite synthetic contract cases only. No cryptographic closure verification, production authorization, effect-owner integration, SCITT trust, Holochain runtime or benchmark result is established.

scenarios.title: Complete request-scoped cut and exact permit witness
scenarios.premise: All required dependencies covered by exact or independently verified ancestry positions
scenarios.invariant: Sufficient cut plus one exact full-context witness permits a candidate Allow
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Resolver marks the dependency inventory incomplete
scenarios.premise: A mandatory issuer/revocation dependency is unavailable or omitted
scenarios.invariant: A permit cannot bypass incomplete required authority evidence
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Dependency closure has no independent verification
scenarios.premise: Producer supplied the dependency list but no independent verifier authenticated completeness
scenarios.invariant: Producer self-assertion is not an independent completeness proof
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Closure receipt refers to a different policy/entity dependency graph snapshot
scenarios.premise: Cut and closure receipt have different dependency graph digests
scenarios.invariant: A completeness claim must bind the exact graph snapshot it evaluated
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Unrelated authority height must not mask a behind required dependency
scenarios.premise: Issuer chain has advanced far beyond requirement but realm membership authority remains behind
scenarios.invariant: Independent authority progress cannot compensate for a missing required component
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Higher sequence without exact ancestry proof is incomparable
scenarios.premise: Current authority sequence is higher but no exact covered-position witness exists for required point
scenarios.invariant: Sequence height is not proof of ancestry
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: One authority supplies multiple independently required dependency roles
scenarios.premise: Membership and role-policy dependencies are both required from the same authority at distinct positions; both are covered
scenarios.invariant: The cut checks every required position, not only one maximum height
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Unrelated authority outside the complete request dependency set is stale
scenarios.premise: Independent closure proof confirms unrelated authority is not a dependency of this request; every required dependency is current
scenarios.invariant: Request-scoped completeness must not require unrelated global convergence
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Complete policy and evidence set has no permit
scenarios.premise: All mandatory dependencies and policy constraints were evaluated; no permit matches
scenarios.invariant: Default deny is meaningful only against a complete policy/evidence set
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Known explicit forbid overrides a permit while another dependency is unavailable
scenarios.premise: A known exact forbid witness applies; a separate dependency is missing
scenarios.invariant: A known forbid remains a safe deny; it does not justify an Allow
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Required policy evaluation is unavailable
scenarios.premise: Policy evaluator cannot establish one mandatory policy/constraint result
scenarios.invariant: Mandatory evaluation errors remain explicit Indeterminate
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Skip-on-error permit trap with missing mandatory authority input
scenarios.premise: A Cedar-style adapter skips an errored policy while another permit matches, but the errored policy's entity/authority dependency is mandatory to this request
scenarios.invariant: Do not convert missing required authority context into a skippable policy error
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Closure receipt is replayed for a different request/audience
scenarios.premise: The closure receipt request digest differs from the exact request digest, including audience/purpose
scenarios.invariant: Audience or purpose substitution invalidates the closure binding
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Closure receipt is replayed under a different realm
scenarios.premise: Realm identifier differs although the request and other fields appear structurally similar
scenarios.invariant: Realm sovereignty is a hard binding, not a tenant label
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Valid SCITT inclusion receipt is presented as permission to execute
scenarios.premise: A transparency receipt proves registration of a signed decision statement but the policy result is Deny
scenarios.invariant: Transparency inclusion does not mint or override authorization
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Authorization receipt says Allow but no effect observation exists yet
scenarios.premise: Exact decision receipt exists; no owner-side effect observation has been received
scenarios.invariant: Allow is not evidence that the protected operation occurred
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Owner-observed effect is committed and bound to exact Allow receipt
scenarios.premise: Effect receipt binds request digest, decision receipt digest, logical operation ID, attempt ID and idempotency key
scenarios.invariant: An observed commit is separately evidenced and bound to the authorization receipt
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Effect outcome is unknown after timeout
scenarios.premise: Attempt 1 may have committed but acknowledgement was lost; no owner reconciliation exists
scenarios.invariant: Unknown must remain unresolved and must block a new logical mutation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Unknown attempt is reconciled as no effect by the effect owner
scenarios.premise: Attempt 1 was Unknown; exact logical-operation/idempotency key is later independently observed as no effect
scenarios.invariant: Only the same logical operation may be retried after exact no-effect reconciliation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Retry changes logical operation ID or idempotency commitment after an unknown outcome
scenarios.premise: Attempt 2 changes logical operation ID or idempotency key while attempt 1 remains unresolved
scenarios.invariant: A timeout cannot be laundered into a new mutation identity
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Two physical attempts produce two committed effects for one logical operation
scenarios.premise: Both attempt receipts claim separate commits under the same logical operation and idempotency key
scenarios.invariant: A committed operation cannot silently execute twice
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Effect owner reports a commit against a Deny receipt
scenarios.premise: Effect receipt binds to an authorization receipt whose outcome is Deny
scenarios.invariant: A downstream effect cannot be described as authorized by a Deny decision
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Decision receipt policy digest is substituted after evaluation
scenarios.premise: A single policy digest byte changes while request and other evidence remain valid
scenarios.invariant: Every security-relevant receipt field is commitment-bound
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.

scenarios.title: Cut digest is substituted while closure verifier claim remains unchanged
scenarios.premise: The caller presents a different canonical cut commitment from the one recorded in the closure receipt
scenarios.invariant: The verifier's completeness claim is tied to one exact dependency set
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic reference contract only; no cryptographic or runtime claim.
